import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    p = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    MOD = 1000000007
    if k == 0:
        ans = pow(p, p - 1, MOD)
        print(ans)
        return
    unvisited = set(range(1, p))
    cycles = 1
    while unvisited:
        start = unvisited.pop()
        j = (start * k) % p
        while j != start:
            unvisited.discard(j)
            j = (j * k) % p
        cycles = (cycles * p) % MOD
    if k == 1:
        cycles = (cycles * p) % MOD
    print(cycles)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
